description: The line plot illustrates the validation performance of two routing policies, SMoE and SimSMoE, as measured by the Bits Per Character (BPC) metric over the course of training. The horizontal axis, labeled “Training Steps (×10³)”, spans from 0 to 50,000 steps with major tick marks at intervals of 10,000 (i.e., 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50), and uses a linear scale. The vertical axis, labeled “BPC”, ranges from 1.2 to 2.2 with major tick marks at intervals of 0.2, also on a linear scale. The black line with triangle markers, labeled “SMoE Validating”, begins at approximately BPC = 2.15 at 0 training steps, drops sharply to around 1.4 by 5,000 steps, and then gradually declines to stabilize near 1.2 by 50,000 steps. The magenta line with diamond markers, labeled “SimSMoE Validating”, starts slightly higher at approximately BPC = 2.2, also drops steeply to about 1.4 by 5,000 steps, and then follows a similar downward trend, stabilizing near 1.2 by 50,000 steps, though it remains slightly above the SMoE line throughout most of the training period. Both lines exhibit a rapid initial decline followed by a slow convergence, indicating improving validation performance over time.
